name: Main Gate
description: The main entrance to the campus. Security desk, visitor registration and the information kiosk are here. Every route in this guide starts at this point.
directions: You are already at the Main Gate – this is the starting point for every route.
Show your student ID card to the security guard at the desk on your right.
Pick up a free campus map from the information kiosk next to the desk.
Walk straight ahead onto Central Avenue to enter the campus.

name: Administration Block
description: Admissions, fee payment counter, ID card office and the Principal's office.
directions: From the Main Gate, walk straight north along Central Avenue.
Continue for about 80 metres (roughly one minute on foot).
The Administration Block, a large white building with a flag out front, is on your left.
Enter through the ground-floor lobby. The fee counter and ID card office are on the right.

name: Central Library
description: Over 50,000 books, journals, silent reading halls and a digital resource centre with free Wi-Fi.
directions: From the Main Gate, walk straight north along Central Avenue, passing the Administration Block on your left.
After about 250 metres you will reach the fountain roundabout.
Take the first exit on the left onto West Lane.
Walk about 170 metres along the tree-lined lane.
The Central Library, a red-brick building, is on your left. The entrance is up the wide stone steps.

name: Student Canteen
description: Affordable meals, snacks, tea and coffee. Indoor and open-air seating, plus a small juice counter.
directions: From the Main Gate, walk straight north along Central Avenue.
After about 250 metres you will reach the fountain roundabout.
Take the first exit on the right onto East Lane.
Walk about 170 metres – you will smell the food before you see it!
The Canteen is the open-sided building on your right, next to the basketball court.

name: Computer Science Labs
description: Four air-conditioned computer labs with high-speed internet, used for programming classes and project work.
directions: From the Main Gate, walk straight north along Central Avenue to the fountain roundabout.
Take the first exit on the left onto West Lane (the same way as the Library).
Walk about 170 metres, with the Library on your left.
The Computer Science Labs, a blue building with glass doors, are on your right – directly opposite the Library.
Take the stairs or lift to the first floor. Lab 1 is at the end of the corridor.

name: Science & Engineering Labs
description: Physics, chemistry and electronics labs. Lab coats and closed shoes are required for entry.
directions: From the Main Gate, walk straight north along Central Avenue to the fountain roundabout.
Take the first exit on the right onto East Lane (the same way as the Canteen).
Walk about 170 metres, with the Canteen on your right.
The Science & Engineering Labs, a grey building with large windows, are on your left – directly opposite the Canteen.
Sign the entry register at the reception desk before going in.

name: Student Hostel
description: Separate residential blocks for boys and girls, with a common room, laundry area and a 24x7 warden desk.
directions: From the Main Gate, walk straight north along Central Avenue.
Go straight through the fountain roundabout, with the two lab buildings off to either side.
Keep walking to the T-junction at the end of the avenue, about 170 metres past the roundabout.
Turn left onto North Lane and walk about 130 metres.
The Hostel gate is on your right. Check in at the warden's desk with your student ID.

name: Sports Ground
description: Cricket field, football pitch, 400 m running track and an indoor gym with changing rooms.
directions: From the Main Gate, walk straight north along Central Avenue.
Go straight through the fountain roundabout and continue to the T-junction at the end of the avenue.
Turn right onto North Lane and walk about 150 metres.
The Sports Ground opens up on your left. Enter through the main turnstile.
The gym and changing rooms are in the building just past the cricket pavilion.
